cover.sub: It's not about willpower. Most people miss #5.

reasons.head: You barely eat during the day
reasons.sub: Skipping meals all day leaves you starving by evening, and that's when it all comes back.

reasons.head: You snack in front of a screen
reasons.sub: Eating while distracted makes you eat more, and even more at your next snack.

reasons.head: You stay up way too late
reasons.sub: In one study, people kept up late ate about 550 extra calories in those late hours.

reasons.head: Food is how you unwind
reasons.sub: After a long day, snacking turns into the reward, even when you're not hungry.

reasons.head: You never count the bites
reasons.sub: A handful here, a spoonful there. Night snacks add up fast and almost never get counted.
